steps.speaker: Victoria Kebbit Monkfish
steps.text: Hello, land dweller.

steps.speaker: Victoria Kebbit Monkfish
steps.text: The sea has been getting quite busy all of a sudden. I surfaced to see what the fuss was about and found that lots of you seem interested in diving down to the sea floor.

steps.speaker: Victoria Kebbit Monkfish
steps.text: I'm offering my services as a guide, for a price. The price in this case, is knowledge!

steps.player: Interesting... It might be good to add some data about the depth of the sea to my charts.

options.text: Can I dive to the sea floor with you?

steps.player: Can I dive to the sea floor with you?

steps.text: If the player is below 38 Sailing:

steps.speaker: Victoria Kebbit Monkfish
steps.text: I don't think you are practised enough to dive here. I don't want you getting swept away!
You need a Sailing level of 38 to dive here.
If you do not have appropriate diving gear equipped:

steps.speaker: Victoria Kebbit Monkfish
steps.text: You need to be wearing deep sea diving equipment to dive with me!

steps.speaker: Victoria Kebbit Monkfish
steps.text: I want something in return if you're going to dive with me...

steps.speaker: Victoria Kebbit Monkfish
steps.text: I'd like to try making some of your land food. Can you tell me the raw ingredients and tools I need to make an apple pie? Don't worry about water. I have plenty of that.

steps.speaker: Victoria Kebbit Monkfish
steps.text: This puzzle has three answers and you'll need to tell me all of them.

steps.speaker: Answers (any order)
steps.text: Cooking Apple, Pot of Flour, Pie Dish
If you answer incorrectly:

steps.speaker: Victoria Kebbit Monkfish
steps.text: I don't think that's right... You should try again.

steps.speaker: Victoria Kebbit Monkfish
steps.text: I'd like to try making some of your land food. Can you tell me the raw ingredients and tools I need to make an apple pie? Don't worry about water. I have plenty of that.

steps.speaker: Victoria Kebbit Monkfish
steps.text: This puzzle has three answers and you'll need to tell me all of them.
If you correctly guess all three items:
The mermaid, satisfied with your answer, escorts you to the bottom of the sea. You take some depth readings from your diving equipment and note down the interesting local flora and fauna.

steps.speaker: Victoria Kebbit Monkfish
steps.text: There you go. Hope the dive got you everything you needed!

steps.speaker: Victoria Kebbit Monkfish
steps.text: Goodbye, land dweller.
